name: cs-concept-tutor
description: Explains a Computer Science concept in simple language and then tests the student with MCQs, scores their answers, and suggests what to revise. Use this skill whenever a CSE student asks to explain, learn, understand, revise, or be tested on any CS topic (OS, DBMS, DSA, computer networks, OOP, algorithms, compilers, computer architecture, system design basics, etc.), especially when they mention college exams, placements, campus interviews, or technical interviews.
